description: The slug and anchor patterns compile in every regular-expression engine: no lookahead, no backreference. Double hyphens and leading or trailing hyphens are excluded by the grammar itself, and the 1-64 bound is a length keyword rather than a quantifier, so RE2, Go and Rust accept the pattern unchanged.
